activity_summary: You said you were here, and that you heard the fire nine days after, from a carter, when it was already out and counted. A man cannot run a hundred miles to a fire. It is a year ago today. The middle of the town burned. The moon is full. You are in London.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the memo at the window, and stayed in.

facets.activity: Said the fire was heard nine days after, from a carter

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I was here. I heard it nine days after, from a carter, and it was all out and counted by then
